verdict.rationale: Calendly can be driven headlessly through its own documented REST API v2. It supports non-interactive personal access tokens for internal or private automation, programmatic booking and data read/write, webhook subscriptions that trigger automations, and a Sandbox environment for testing. There is no evidence of a CLI, CI-specific tooling or guidance, or service-account-style credentials for pipelines, so headless use is API-only rather than a first-class CI mode. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration docs, service-account or CI credential guidance, independent hands-on evidence of pipeline use.
